# 1. Setup

```{r libraries}

library(REDCapR)
```

# 2. Load data from REDCap

```{r tokens}
readRenviron("C:/Users/saehyeun.song/Documents/.Renviron")

uri <- "https://ivirdc.ivi.int/api/"

token_names <- c(
  MLW_HOS  = "SAVAC_MLW_HOS_TOKEN_IVI",
  PGI_HOS  = "SAVAC_PGI_HOS_TOKEN_PID181",
  MRCG_HOS = "SAVAC_MRCG_HOS_TOKEN_IVI"
)

tokens <- Sys.getenv(token_names)
names(tokens) <- names(token_names)

# Stop if any token is missing
missing <- names(tokens)[tokens == ""]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("Missing tokens in .Renviron: ", paste(token_names[missing], collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r load-functions}
# Read records from one project ("raw" or "label")
read_redcap <- function(token, site, raw_or_label = "raw") {
  message("> ", site, " [", raw_or_label, "] loading...")
  res <- REDCapR::redcap_read(
    redcap_uri   = uri,
    token        = token,
    raw_or_label = raw_or_label,
    batch_size   = 500,
    verbose      = FALSE
  )
  if (!res$success) {
    warning(site, " [", raw_or_label, "] failed: ", res$outcome_message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  message("  OK: ", nrow(res$data), " rows / ", ncol(res$data), " cols")
  res$data
}

# Read data dictionary from one project
read_metadata <- function(token, site) {
  message("> ", site, " [metadata] loading...")
  res <- REDCapR::redcap_metadata_read(redcap_uri = uri, token = token, verbose = FALSE)
  if (!res$success) {
    warning(site, " [metadata] failed: ", res$outcome_message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  res$data
}
```

```{r load-data}
dat_raw   <- imap(tokens, read_redcap, raw_or_label = "raw")    # coded values
dat_label <- imap(tokens, read_redcap, raw_or_label = "label")  # choice labels
meta      <- imap(tokens, read_metadata)                         # data dictionaries

mlw_hos_raw  <- dat_raw$MLW_HOS
pgi_hos_raw  <- dat_raw$PGI_HOS
mrcg_hos_raw <- dat_raw$MRCG_HOS

mlw_hos_lab  <- dat_label$MLW_HOS
pgi_hos_lab  <- dat_label$PGI_HOS
mrcg_hos_lab <- dat_label$MRCG_HOS

mlw_hos_meta  <- meta$MLW_HOS
pgi_hos_meta  <- meta$PGI_HOS
mrcg_hos_meta <- meta$MRCG_HOS
```

# 3. Build RHD datasets

- MLW / PGI: `redcap_event_name == "rhd_arm_1"`, keep ID/REDCap columns + variables starting with `rh`
- MRCG: any `rhd_ppc_adm___1`-`___10` checked (== 1), keep all variables

```{r rhd-datasets}
# MLW
mlw_rhd_idx <- which(mlw_hos_raw$redcap_event_name %in% "rhd_arm_1")
mlw_rhd <- mlw_hos_raw[mlw_rhd_idx, ] %>%
  select(record_id, starts_with("redcap_"), starts_with("rh"))
mlw_rhd_lab <- mlw_hos_lab[mlw_rhd_idx, ] %>%
  select(record_id, starts_with("redcap_"), starts_with("rh"))

# PGI
pgi_rhd_idx <- which(pgi_hos_raw$redcap_event_name %in% "rhd_arm_1")
pgi_rhd <- pgi_hos_raw[pgi_rhd_idx, ] %>%
  select(record_id, starts_with("redcap_"), starts_with("rh"))
pgi_rhd_lab <- pgi_hos_lab[pgi_rhd_idx, ] %>%
  select(record_id, starts_with("redcap_"), starts_with("rh"))

# MRCG
mrcg_rhd_idx <- which(rowSums(mrcg_hos_raw[grep("^rhd_ppc_adm___", names(mrcg_hos_raw))] == 1,
                              na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
mrcg_rhd     <- mrcg_hos_raw[mrcg_rhd_idx, ]
mrcg_rhd_lab <- mrcg_hos_lab[mrcg_rhd_idx, ]
```


```{r summary-response}
# Response codes for rh_ic / rh_no_ic
mlw_hos_meta %>%
  filter(field_name %in% c("rh_ic", "rh_no_ic")) %>%
  select(field_name, select_choices_or_calculations)

# Count unique records per response value; skip if variable not in dataset
count_resp <- function(df, var, site) {
  if (!var %in% names(df)) return(NULL)
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    distinct(record_id, value = as.character(.data[[var]])) %>%
    count(value) %>%
    mutate(site = site, col = paste0(var, "_", value))
}

resp_counts <- bind_rows(
  count_resp(mlw_rhd,  "rh_ic",    "MLW"),
  count_resp(mlw_rhd,  "rh_no_ic", "MLW"),
  count_resp(pgi_rhd,  "rh_ic",    "PGI"),
  count_resp(pgi_rhd,  "rh_no_ic", "PGI"),
  count_resp(mrcg_rhd, "rh_ic",    "MRCG"),
  count_resp(mrcg_rhd, "rh_no_ic", "MRCG")
)

# Long format
resp_counts %>% select(site, col, n)

# Wide format: one column per response
resp_wide <- resp_counts %>%
  select(site, col, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
resp_wide <- resp_wide %>%
  select(site, sort(setdiff(names(resp_wide), "site")))
```

# 7. RHD variables - summary by site

Target records = RHD enrolled records (same definition as `n_enrolled_rhd`),
using rows of the RHD event (`rhd_arm_1`).
All variables matching `var_prefix` (default: starting with `rh`, i.e. `rh_`,
`rhd_`, `rhf_`) are summarised by variable type and compared side by side across
sites. Questions (field labels) and answers (choice labels) are taken from each
site's data dictionary. Branching logic is applied per variable to set the
denominator (same approach as the Data Status Report).

Steps:

1. Combined data dictionary - union of selected variables and choices across sites
2. Site values filled in by the combined dictionary
3. Completeness overview - one row per variable, answered / denominator per site
4. Detail tables - one comparison table per variable

## 7.1 Settings

```{r trig-settings}
site_labels <- c(MLW_HOS = "MLW", PGI_HOS = "PGI", MRCG_HOS = "MRCG")

# Variables to compare (regex on field_name): rh_, rhd_, rhf_ ...
var_prefix <- "^rh"

# RHD event per site (NA = no event filter)
map(dat_raw, ~ table(.x$redcap_event_name))
target_event <- c(MLW_HOS = "rhd_arm_1", PGI_HOS = "rhd_arm_1", MRCG_HOS = NA)

# System / helper fields to exclude
exclude_pattern <- "_warn|_entdt_server|_entdt_now|_entby_web|_entby_app"

# Completeness below this % is highlighted in the overview
low_threshold <- 90

# Variable mapping to MLW (reference) variables, one file per site
# NA = site uses MLW variable names as is (a name check file is saved for it)
varmap_dir  <- "varmap"
varmap_file <- c(MLW_HOS  = NA,
                 PGI_HOS  = file.path(varmap_dir, "SAVAC_HOS_varmap_PGI.xlsx"),
                 MRCG_HOS = file.path(varmap_dir, "SAVAC_HOS_varmap_MRCG.xlsx"))

# Target records per site
target_ids <- list(
  MLW_HOS  = mlw_rhd  %>% filter(!is.na(rh_ic) | !is.na(rh_no_ic)) %>% pull(record_id) %>% unique(),
  PGI_HOS  = pgi_rhd  %>% filter(!is.na(rh_ic) | !is.na(rh_no_ic)) %>% pull(record_id) %>% unique(),
  MRCG_HOS = mrcg_rhd %>% pull(record_id) %>% unique()
)
lengths(target_ids)

# Forms containing the selected variables per site
map(meta, ~ unique(.x$form_name[grepl(var_prefix, .x$field_name)]))
```

## 7.2 Functions

```{r trig-functions}
strip_html <- function(x) trimws(gsub("<.*?>", "", x))

# Data dictionary of selected variables with variable type
classify_fields <- function(m) {
  m %>%
    filter(grepl(var_prefix, field_name),
           field_type != "descriptive",
           !grepl(exclude_pattern, field_name)) %>%
    mutate(
      field_label = strip_html(field_label),
      validation  = coalesce(text_validation_type_or_show_slider_number, ""),
      var_type = case_when(
        field_type %in% c("radio", "dropdown", "yesno", "truefalse")  ~ "Cate",
        field_type == "checkbox"                                      ~ "Check",
        field_type == "calc"                                          ~ "Calc",
        field_type == "slider"                                        ~ "Cont",
        field_type == "text" & grepl("^date", validation)             ~ "Date",
        field_type == "text" & grepl("^time", validation)             ~ "Time",
        field_type == "text" & grepl("^(number|integer)", validation) ~ "Cont",
        TRUE                                                          ~ "Text"
      ),
      choices = case_when(
        field_type == "yesno"     ~ "1, Yes | 0, No",
        field_type == "truefalse" ~ "1, True | 0, False",
        TRUE                      ~ select_choices_or_calculations
      )
    )
}

# "1, Yes | 0, No" -> code / label table
parse_choices <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || s == "") return(tibble(code = character(), label = character()))
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(s, "\\|")[[1]])
  tibble(code  = trimws(sub(",.*$", "", parts)),
         label = strip_html(sub("^[^,]*,", "", parts)))
}

# REDCap branching logic -> R expression
logic_to_r <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") return(NA_character_)
  x <- gsub("\n", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[event-name\\]", "[redcap_event_name]", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[[^]]*_arm_[^]]*\\]", "", x)                            # drop [event_arm_1] prefix
  x <- gsub("\\]\\[current-instance\\]", "]", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\(([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\\)\\]", "[\\1___\\2]", x)     # checkbox [var(1)]
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\]\\s*<>\\s*(''|\"\")", "!is.na(\\1)", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\]\\s*=\\s*(''|\"\")", "is.na(\\1)", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\]", "\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("<>", "!=", x)
  x <- gsub("(?<![<>!=])=(?!=)", "==", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\band\\b", "&", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\bor\\b", "|", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x
}

# Keep rows meeting branching logic; if logic cannot be evaluated, keep all rows
apply_logic <- function(dat, logic) {
  cond <- logic_to_r(logic)
  if (is.na(cond)) return(list(dat = dat, applied = NA))
  keep <- tryCatch(eval(parse(text = cond), envir = dat), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(keep) && length(keep) == 1) keep <- rep(keep, nrow(dat))
  if (is.null(keep) || length(keep) != nrow(dat)) return(list(dat = dat, applied = FALSE))
  list(dat = dat[keep %in% TRUE, , drop = FALSE], applied = TRUE)
}

# Rows of target records (in the given event) where any selected variable has a response
get_form_rows <- function(df, dict, ids, event = NA) {
  df <- df %>% filter(record_id %in% ids)
  if (!is.na(event)) df <- df %>% filter(redcap_event_name == event)
  check_fields <- dict$field_name[dict$var_type == "Check"]
  other_fields <- dict$field_name[!dict$var_type %in% c("Check", "Calc")]
  cols <- names(df)[names(df) %in% other_fields |
                    sub("___.*$", "", names(df)) %in% check_fields]
  if (length(cols) == 0 || nrow(df) == 0) return(df[0, ])
  answered <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(cols, function(cl) {
    if (grepl("___", cl)) df[[cl]] %in% c(1, "1")
    else !is.na(df[[cl]]) & trimws(as.character(df[[cl]])) != ""
  }))
  df[answered, , drop = FALSE]
}

fmt_n_pct <- function(k, d) {
  if (d == 0) return(as.character(k))
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", as.integer(k), k / d * 100)
}
fmt_num <- function(v, digits = 1) formatC(v, format = "f", digits = digits)

# Summary of one variable for one site
# d:  this site's dictionary row; mc: master choices of the field (code, label, ord)
# tab: rows (row, value, ord); ord 900 = Missing / None checked, 999 = Total
# k: number answered, n: denominator after branching logic
# Choices not offered at this site are shown as "-"
summarise_var <- function(dat, d, mc) {
  lg  <- apply_logic(dat, d$branching_logic)
  dat <- lg$dat
  n   <- nrow(dat)
  f   <- d$field_name
  site_codes <- parse_choices(d$choices)$code

  if (d$var_type != "Check" && !f %in% names(dat)) {
    tab <- tibble(row = "Not exported", value = "-", ord = 1)
    k   <- NA_integer_
  } else if (d$var_type == "Cate") {
    x   <- as.character(dat[[f]])
    cnt <- vapply(mc$code, function(cd) sum(x %in% cd), integer(1))
    val <- ifelse(mc$code %in% site_codes, fmt_n_pct(cnt, n), "-")
    # Values not in the dictionary, shown as raw code
    unk     <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(x)), mc$code)
    unk_lab <- if (length(unk) > 0) paste0("[code ", unk, "]") else character(0)
    unk_val <- if (length(unk) > 0) fmt_n_pct(vapply(unk, function(cd) sum(x %in% cd), integer(1)), n) else character(0)
    k   <- sum(!is.na(x))
    tab <- tibble(row   = c(mc$label, unk_lab, "Missing"),
                  value = c(val, unk_val, fmt_n_pct(n - k, n)),
                  ord   = c(mc$ord, 800 + seq_along(unk), 900))
  } else if (d$var_type == "Check") {
    cols <- paste0(f, "___", tolower(gsub("-", "_", mc$code)))
    hit  <- lapply(cols, function(cl) if (cl %in% names(dat)) dat[[cl]] %in% c(1, "1") else NULL)
    has  <- !vapply(hit, is.null, logical(1))
    cnt  <- vapply(hit, function(h) if (is.null(h)) 0L else sum(h), integer(1))
    none <- if (any(has)) sum(Reduce(`+`, hit[has]) == 0) else n
    k    <- n - none
    tab <- tibble(row   = c(mc$label, "None checked"),
                  value = c(ifelse(has, fmt_n_pct(cnt, n), "-"), fmt_n_pct(none, n)),
                  ord   = c(mc$ord, 900))
  } else if (d$var_type %in% c("Cont", "Calc")) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dat[[f]])))
    k <- sum(!is.na(v))
    tab <- tibble(
      row   = c("N", "Missing", "Mean (SD)", "Median", "Min, Max"),
      value = c(as.character(k),
                fmt_n_pct(n - k, n),
                if (k > 0) paste0(fmt_num(mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)), " (", fmt_num(sd(v, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ")") else "-",
                if (k > 0) fmt_num(median(v, na.rm = TRUE)) else "-",
                if (k > 0) paste0(fmt_num(min(v, na.rm = TRUE)), ", ", fmt_num(max(v, na.rm = TRUE))) else "-"),
      ord   = c(1, 900, 2, 3, 4)
    )
  } else if (d$var_type %in% c("Date", "Time")) {
    v <- as.character(dat[[f]])
    v <- v[!is.na(v) & v != ""]
    k <- length(v)
    tab <- tibble(row   = c("N", "Missing", "Min", "Max"),
                  value = c(as.character(k), fmt_n_pct(n - k, n),
                            if (k > 0) min(v) else "-", if (k > 0) max(v) else "-"),
                  ord   = c(1, 900, 2, 3))
  } else {
    v <- as.character(dat[[f]])
    answered <- !is.na(v) & trimws(v) != ""
    k <- sum(answered)
    tab <- tibble(row   = c("N", "Missing", "Unique values"),
                  value = c(as.character(k), fmt_n_pct(n - k, n),
                            as.character(length(unique(v[answered])))),
                  ord   = c(1, 900, 2))
  }

  tab <- bind_rows(tab, tibble(row = "Total", value = as.character(n), ord = 999))
  list(tab = tab, applied = lg$applied, k = as.integer(k), n = n)
}

# Detail comparison flextable for one variable (question label in header)
make_compare_ft <- function(tab, header_n, question) {
  ft <- flextable(tab)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = c(list(row = question), as.list(header_n)))
  ft <- bold(ft, i = ~ row == "Total")
  ft <- color(ft, i = ~ row %in% c("Missing", "None checked"), j = 1, color = "#C00000")
  ft <- bold(ft, i = ~ row %in% c("Missing", "None checked"), j = 1)
  if (nrow(tab) > 1) ft <- hline(ft, i = nrow(tab) - 1, border = fp_border(width = 2))
  ft <- align(ft, j = 2:ncol(tab), align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- width(ft, j = 1, width = 2.8)
  ft <- width(ft, j = 2:ncol(tab), width = 1.3)
  ft
}
```

## 7.3 Harmonise sites to MLW variables

Sites with a varmap file (PGI, MRCG) are converted to MLW variable names and coding:
each `site_expr` is evaluated on one row per record (checkbox = checked in any
row, other fields = first non-missing value; `row_filter` limits the rows used).
The MLW data dictionary is then used for these sites, so questions, answers and
order are the same as MLW. Unmapped MLW variables show as "Not in form".

```{r harmonise}
# Helpers available in varmap site_expr
to_date <- function(x) as.Date(as.character(x))
yn12    <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% 1, 1, ifelse(x %in% 0, 2, NA))   # yes/no 1/0 -> 1 Yes / 2 No
chk     <- function(cond) as.integer(cond %in% TRUE)                   # condition -> checkbox 1/0

first_value <- function(v) { x <- v[!is.na(v)]; if (length(x) > 0) x[1] else v[NA_integer_] }
max_value   <- function(v) if (all(is.na(v))) NA_real_ else max(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)), na.rm = TRUE)

# One row per record: checkbox columns = checked in any row, others = first non-missing value
collapse_record <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    group_by(record_id) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(),
                     ~ if (grepl("___", cur_column())) max_value(.x) else first_value(.x)),
              .groups = "drop")
}

# Convert one site's data to MLW variables using its varmap
harmonise_site <- function(df, site_meta, vm, ids) {
  vm <- vm %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ coalesce(as.character(.x), ""))) %>%
    filter(ref_field != "", site_expr != "")
  df <- df %>% filter(record_id %in% ids)

  # Code -> choice label of a site field (used as lab("field", x) in site_expr)
  lab <- function(field, x) {
    ch <- parse_choices(site_meta$select_choices_or_calculations[site_meta$field_name == field][1])
    ch$label[match(as.character(x), ch$code)]
  }
  env <- environment()

  # Site columns used by expressions and filters
  toks <- unique(unlist(regmatches(c(vm$site_expr, vm$row_filter),
                                   gregexpr("[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*", c(vm$site_expr, vm$row_filter)))))
  used <- names(df)[names(df) %in% toks | sub("___.*$", "", names(df)) %in% toks]
  cols <- unique(c("record_id", used))
  rec  <- collapse_record(df[, cols, drop = FALSE])

  out <- tibble(record_id = rec$record_id)
  log <- vector("list", nrow(vm))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(vm))) {
    ref  <- vm$ref_field[i]
    expr <- vm$site_expr[i]
    filt <- vm$row_filter[i]

    dat <- rec
    if (filt != "") {
      keep <- tryCatch(eval(parse(text = filt), envir = df, enclos = env), error = function(e) NULL)
      dat  <- if (is.null(keep)) rec[0, ] else collapse_record(df[keep %in% TRUE, cols, drop = FALSE])
    }
    m <- match(out$record_id, dat$record_id)

    cb_cols <- if (grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$", expr)) grep(paste0("^", expr, "___"), names(dat), value = TRUE) else character(0)
    if (!grepl("___", ref) && length(cb_cols) > 0) {
      # Bare checkbox field: copy all options with the same codes
      for (cl in cb_cols) out[[sub(paste0("^", expr), ref, cl)]] <- dat[[cl]][m]
      status <- "ok"
    } else {
      val <- tryCatch(eval(parse(text = expr), envir = dat, enclos = env), error = function(e) e)
      if (inherits(val, "error")) {
        status <- conditionMessage(val)
      } else {
        if (length(val) == 1) val <- rep(val, nrow(dat))
        out[[ref]] <- val[m]
        status <- "ok"
      }
    }
    log[[i]] <- tibble(ref_field = ref, site_expr = expr, status = status)
  }

  out <- out %>% mutate(redcap_event_name = NA_character_, redcap_repeat_instrument = NA_character_)
  list(data = out, log = bind_rows(log))
}

# Read a varmap file: the .xlsx, or the .csv with the same name if the .xlsx is not there
read_varmap <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) return(read_excel(path, sheet = "varmap"))
  csv <- sub("\\.xlsx$", ".csv", path)
  if (!file.exists(csv)) stop("varmap file not found: ", path, " (or ", csv, ")")
  tibble::as_tibble(read.csv(csv, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", na.strings = "",
                             colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE))
}

# Harmonise sites with a varmap file
varmap <- map(varmap_file[!is.na(varmap_file)], read_varmap)

# Rows with site fields filled in but no site_expr are not used (check these)
map(varmap, ~ .x %>%
      filter(!is.na(ref_field), !is.na(site_fields), is.na(site_expr)) %>%
      select(ref_field, match, site_fields, note))

harm   <- imap(varmap, function(vm, s) harmonise_site(dat_raw[[s]], meta[[s]], vm, target_ids[[s]]))

# Expressions that could not be evaluated (should be empty)
map(harm, ~ .x$log %>% filter(status != "ok"))

# Data, dictionary and event used for the comparison
dat_cmp   <- dat_raw
meta_cmp  <- meta
event_cmp <- target_event
for (s in names(harm)) {
  mapped         <- unique(sub("___.*$", "", names(harm[[s]]$data)))
  dat_cmp[[s]]   <- harm[[s]]$data
  meta_cmp[[s]]  <- meta$MLW_HOS %>% filter(field_name %in% mapped)
  event_cmp[[s]] <- NA
}
map_int(meta_cmp, nrow)

# Name check for sites using MLW names as is (saved as that site's matching file)
ref_dict <- classify_fields(meta$MLW_HOS)
for (s in setdiff(names(varmap_file)[is.na(varmap_file)], "MLW_HOS")) {
  name_check <- ref_dict %>%
    select(ref_field = field_name, ref_form = form_name, ref_label = field_label, ref_choices = choices) %>%
    left_join(classify_fields(meta[[s]]) %>%
                select(ref_field = field_name, site_label = field_label, site_choices = choices),
              by = "ref_field") %>%
    mutate(match = case_when(
      is.na(site_label)                                                  ~ "Not available",
      site_label == ref_label &
        coalesce(site_choices, "") == coalesce(ref_choices, "")          ~ "Exact (same name)",
      TRUE                                                               ~ "Same name, definition differs"
    ))
  dir.create(varmap_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_xlsx(list(varmap = name_check),
             file.path(varmap_dir, paste0("SAVAC_HOS_varmap_", site_labels[[s]], "_namecheck.xlsx")))
  print(count(name_check, match))
}
```

```{r trig-build}
trig_dict <- map(meta_cmp, classify_fields)
trig_rows <- imap(trig_dict, function(d, s) {

})

# Site overview
trig_overview <- tibble(
  site           = unname(site_labels[names(trig_dict)]),
  source         = ifelse(is.na(varmap_file[names(trig_dict)]), "own variables", "mapped to MLW (varmap)"),
  forms          = map_chr(trig_dict, ~ paste(unique(.x$form_name), collapse = ", ")),

)
trig_overview
```

## 7.5 Combined data dictionary

One row per variable across all sites. Question, type, choices and branching
logic come from the first site where the variable appears (MLW > PGI > MRCG);
differences between sites are flagged in `issues`.

```{r trig-dictionary}
# Stop early if no variable matches var_prefix
if (sum(map_int(trig_dict, nrow)) == 0) {
  stop("No variables match var_prefix = '", var_prefix, "'. ",
       "Check names with: map(meta, ~ grep(var_prefix, .x$field_name, value = TRUE))")
}

# All sites' dictionaries stacked (pos = order of first appearance)
dict_all <- bind_rows(trig_dict, .id = "site_key") %>%
  mutate(site = unname(site_labels[site_key]),
         pos  = row_number())

# Master dictionary: one row per variable
master_dict <- dict_all %>%
  group_by(field_name) %>%
  summarise(
    # Difference flags first (before the columns are collapsed to one value)
    diff_type       = n_distinct(var_type) > 1,
    diff_label      = n_distinct(field_label) > 1,
    diff_choices    = n_distinct(coalesce(choices, "")) > 1,
    diff_logic      = n_distinct(coalesce(branching_logic, "")) > 1,
    sites           = paste(site, collapse = ", "),
    pos             = min(pos),
    form_name       = first(form_name),
    var_type        = first(var_type),
    field_label     = first(field_label),
    choices         = first(choices),
    branching_logic = first(branching_logic),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(pos) %>%
  select(-pos)

# Question label per site (side by side)
label_by_site <- dict_all %>%
  select(field_name, site, field_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = field_label, names_prefix = "label_")

# Text summary of differences for one variable
make_issues <- function(sites, diff_type, diff_label, diff_choices, diff_logic) {
  not_in <- setdiff(site_labels, strsplit(sites, ", ")[[1]])
  paste(c(
    if (length(not_in) > 0) paste0("Not in ", paste(not_in, collapse = ", ")),
    if (diff_type)    "Type differs",
    if (diff_label)   "Question differs",
    if (diff_choices) "Choices differ",
    if (diff_logic)   "Branching logic differs"
  ), collapse = "; ")
}

master_dict <- master_dict %>%
  left_join(label_by_site, by = "field_name")
master_dict$issues <- pmap_chr(
  master_dict[c("sites", "diff_type", "diff_label", "diff_choices", "diff_logic")],
  make_issues
)

master_dict

# Master choices: union of codes across sites (order: first site, then new codes)
cate_dict <- dict_all %>% filter(var_type %in% c("Cate", "Check"))

choices_all <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(cate_dict)), function(i) {
  parse_choices(cate_dict$choices[i]) %>%
    mutate(field_name = cate_dict$field_name[i],
           site       = cate_dict$site[i],
           .before = 1)
})
# Keep expected columns even when there are no categorical variables
if (nrow(choices_all) == 0) {
  choices_all <- tibble(field_name = character(), site = character(),
                        code = character(), label = character())
}

master_choices <- choices_all %>%
  distinct(field_name, code, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(field_name) %>%
  mutate(ord = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(field_name, code, label, ord)

# Answer label per site (side by side) for checking
choices_by_site <- master_choices %>%
  left_join(choices_all %>%
              select(field_name, code, site, site_label = label) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = site_label, names_prefix = "label_"),
            by = c("field_name", "code"))

choices_by_site

# Variables with differences between sites
dict_issues <- master_dict %>%
  filter(issues != "") %>%
  select(field_name, field_label, sites, issues)
dict_issues
```

## 7.6 Site values by master dictionary

```{r trig-values}

trig_compare <- map(seq_len(nrow(master_dict)), function(i) {
  fld <- master_dict$field_name[i]
  mc  <- master_choices %>% filter(field_name == fld) %>% select(code, label, ord)

  # Summary per site (NULL if the field is not in that site's dictionary)
  res <- imap(trig_dict, function(d, s) {
    dd <- d %>% filter(field_name == fld)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(NULL)
    summarise_var(trig_rows[[s]], dd[1, ], mc)
  })

  # Detail table
  long <- imap_dfr(compact(res), ~ .x$tab %>%
                     mutate(site = site_labels[[.y]], logic_applied = .x$applied))
  wide <- long %>%
    group_by(row) %>% mutate(ord = min(ord)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    select(row, ord, site, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = value, values_fill = "-") %>%
    arrange(ord) %>%
    select(-ord)
  for (s in site_labels) if (!s %in% names(wide)) wide[[s]] <- "Not in form"
  wide <- wide %>% select(row, all_of(unname(site_labels)))

  # Completeness per site
  comp <- imap_dfr(res, function(r, s) {
    if (is.null(r)) return(tibble(site = site_labels[[s]], k = NA_integer_, n = NA_integer_,
                                  pct = NA_real_, cell = "Not in form"))
    if (is.na(r$k)) return(tibble(site = site_labels[[s]], k = NA_integer_, n = r$n,
                                  pct = NA_real_, cell = "Not exported"))
    pct <- if (r$n > 0) r$k / r$n * 100 else NA_real_
    tibble(site = site_labels[[s]], k = r$k, n = r$n, pct = pct,
           cell = if (r$n > 0) sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", r$k, r$n, pct) else "0/0")
  })

  list(
    field      = fld,
    label      = master_dict$field_label[i],
    type       = master_dict$var_type[i],
    logic      = master_dict$branching_logic[i],
    issues     = master_dict$issues[i],
    logic_fail = unique(long$site[long$logic_applied %in% FALSE]),
    table      = wide,
    comp       = comp
  )
})

# Completeness overview (one row per variable)
trig_completeness <- map_dfr(trig_compare, ~ .x$comp %>%
                               mutate(field = .x$field, label = .x$label, type = .x$type, .before = 1))

completeness_wide <- trig_completeness %>%
  select(field, label, type, site, cell, pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = c(cell, pct))

overview_cells <- completeness_wide %>%
  select(field, label, type, all_of(paste0("cell_", site_labels))) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^cell_", "", .x))
overview_pct <- completeness_wide %>%
  select(all_of(paste0("pct_", site_labels))) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^pct_", "", .x))

overview_cells

# Long table of all detail rows (for checking / Excel)
trig_compare_long <- map_dfr(trig_compare, ~ .x$table %>%
                               rename(response = row) %>%
                               mutate(field = .x$field, question = .x$label, type = .x$type, .before = 1))
trig_compare_long
```

# 8. RHD cases - counts, age groups, enrolment dates, ID lists

Cases = RHD target records (section 7.1), one row per record. Uses the
harmonised data (section 7.3), so all sites have MLW variables:
enrolment date = `rh_ic_dt`, age = `rh_age_year` (or `rh_age_month` / `rh_age_day`
if under 1 year). For MRCG these come from `cda_dt_con` and `cda_dob_cal_yrs`
through the varmap file.

## 8.1 Settings

```{r cases-settings}
# Age groups (completed years)
age_breaks <- c(-Inf, 5, 15, 19, Inf)
age_labels <- c("<5", "5-14", "15-18", "19+")
```

## 8.2 Build case list

```{r cases-build}
# One row per case: record_id, enrolment date, age
build_cases <- function(s) {
  df <- dat_cmp[[s]] %>% filter(record_id %in% target_ids[[s]])
  if (!is.na(event_cmp[[s]])) df <- df %>% filter(redcap_event_name == event_cmp[[s]])
  if ("redcap_repeat_instrument" %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% filter(is.na(redcap_repeat_instrument))

  # Variables missing at a site are added as NA
  for (v in c("rh_ic_dt", "rh_age_year", "rh_age_month", "rh_age_day")) {
    if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      warning(s, ": ", v, " not found")
      df[[v]] <- NA
    }
  }

  df %>%
    transmute(
      record_id = as.character(record_id),
      enrol_dt  = to_date(rh_ic_dt),
      # Age in years; months / days used only when years is missing (under 1 year)
      age_years = coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rh_age_year)),
                           suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rh_age_month)) / 12,
                           suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rh_age_day)) / 365.25)
    ) %>%
    # Collapse to one row per record (first non-missing value)
    group_by(record_id) %>%
    summarise(enrol_dt  = first_value(enrol_dt),
              age_years = first_value(age_years),
              .groups   = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      age_group = cut(floor(age_years), breaks = age_breaks, labels = age_labels, right = FALSE),
      age_group = factor(coalesce(as.character(age_group), "Missing"),
                         levels = c(age_labels, "Missing"))
    )
}

cases_all <- imap_dfr(site_labels, function(lbl, s) {
  build_cases(s) %>% mutate(site = lbl, .before = 1)
}) %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_labels))

# Duplicate check (should be empty)
cases_all %>% count(site, record_id) %>% filter(n > 1)
```

## 8.3 Summary tables

```{r cases-summary}
safe_min <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) as.Date(NA) else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_max <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) as.Date(NA) else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

# Total cases and enrolment date range per site
case_summary <- cases_all %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(n_cases          = n_distinct(record_id),
            enrol_first      = safe_min(enrol_dt),
            enrol_last       = safe_max(enrol_dt),
            missing_enrol_dt = sum(is.na(enrol_dt)),
            missing_age      = sum(is.na(age_years)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site))

case_summary <- case_summary %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(site             = "Total",
                   n_cases          = sum(case_summary$n_cases),
                   enrol_first      = safe_min(case_summary$enrol_first),
                   enrol_last       = safe_max(case_summary$enrol_last),
                   missing_enrol_dt = sum(case_summary$missing_enrol_dt),
                   missing_age      = sum(case_summary$missing_age)))
case_summary

# Cases by age group per site
case_age <- cases_all %>%
  count(site, age_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site), Total = rowSums(across(-site)))

case_age <- case_age %>%
  bind_rows(case_age %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>% mutate(site = "Total"))
case_age

# ID list per site
case_ids <- map(site_labels, function(lbl) {
  cases_all %>%
    filter(site == lbl) %>%
    transmute(record_id, enrol_dt, age_years = round(age_years, 1), age_group) %>%
    arrange(enrol_dt, record_id)
}) %>%
  set_names(paste0("ids_", site_labels))
map_int(case_ids, nrow)
```

# 9. Word report

One Word file: RHD case summary first, then the RHD variable comparison (section 7).

## 9.1 Case summary

```{r word-cases}
doc <- if (file.exists("DocStyle.docx")) read_docx("DocStyle.docx") else read_docx()

fmt_date <- function(x) coalesce(format(x, "%d %b %Y"), "-")

# Summary flextable: bold Total row with a line above it
make_summary_ft <- function(df, labels = list()) {
  ft <- flextable(df)
  if (length(labels) > 0) ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = labels)
  tot <- which(df[[1]] == "Total")
  if (length(tot) > 0) {
    ft <- bold(ft, i = tot)
    if (tot > 1) ft <- hline(ft, i = tot - 1, border = fp_border(width = 2))
  }
  ft <- align(ft, j = 2:ncol(df), align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 9, part = "all")
  autofit(ft)
}

doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Hospital - RHD cases", style = "heading 1")
doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("Cases: RHD enrolled records. Created ", format(Sys.Date(), "%d %b %Y"), "."))

# Number of cases and enrolment period
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Number of cases and enrolment period", style = "heading 2")
cs <- case_summary %>% mutate(across(c(enrol_first, enrol_last), fmt_date))
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_summary_ft(cs, list(
  site = "Site", n_cases = "Cases", enrol_first = "First enrolment", enrol_last = "Last enrolment",
  missing_enrol_dt = "Missing enrolment date", missing_age = "Missing age")))
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Enrolment date = date of obtaining consent / assent (rh_ic_dt).")
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")

# Number of cases by age group, n (% of site total)
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Number of cases by age group", style = "heading 2")
ca <- case_age %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(age_labels, "Missing")),
                ~ sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", as.integer(.x), ifelse(Total > 0, .x / Total * 100, 0))))
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_summary_ft(ca, list(site = "Site")))
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Age in completed years at enrolment; % of site total.")

# Case ID list per site
doc <- body_add_break(doc)
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Case ID list by site", style = "heading 2")
for (nm in names(case_ids)) {
  ids <- case_ids[[nm]] %>% mutate(enrol_dt = fmt_date(enrol_dt))
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0(sub("^ids_", "", nm), " (N = ", nrow(ids), ")"), style = "heading 3")
  if (nrow(ids) == 0) {
    doc <- body_add_par(doc, "No cases.")
    next
  }
  ft <- flextable(ids)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, record_id = "Record ID", enrol_dt = "Enrolment date",
                          age_years = "Age (years)", age_group = "Age group")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 2:4, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 8, part = "all")
  ft <- autofit(ft)
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")
}
doc <- body_add_break(doc)
```

## 9.2 RHD variables summary by site

```{r trig-word}
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Hospital - RHD variables summary by site", style = "heading 1")
doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("Target records: RHD enrolled records. Created ", format(Sys.Date(), "%d %b %Y"), "."))

# Site overview

ft_site <- set_header_labels(ft_site, site = "Site", source = "Variables source", forms = "Form(s)",

if (nrow(dict_issues) > 0) {

  ft_iss <- set_header_labels(ft_iss, field_name = "Variable", field_label = "Question",

doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")

# Completeness overview
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Completeness overview", style = "heading 2")
doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("Answered / denominator (after branching logic). Red: below ",
                                low_threshold, "%. Grey: not in form or not exported."))

ft_comp <- flextable(overview_cells)
ft_comp <- set_header_labels(ft_comp, field = "Variable", label = "Question", type = "Type")
for (s in site_labels) {
  low <- which(!is.na(overview_pct[[s]]) & overview_pct[[s]] < low_threshold)
  na  <- which(overview_cells[[s]] %in% c("Not in form", "Not exported"))
  if (length(low) > 0) ft_comp <- bg(ft_comp, i = low, j = s, bg = "#F8D7DA")
  if (length(na)  > 0) ft_comp <- bg(ft_comp, i = na,  j = s, bg = "#E7E6E6")
}
ft_comp <- align(ft_comp, j = c("type", site_labels), align = "center", part = "all")
ft_comp <- fontsize(ft_comp, size = 8, part = "all")
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = "field", width = 1.2)
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = "label", width = 2.4)
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = "type",  width = 0.5)
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = site_labels, width = 1.0)
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_comp)
doc <- body_add_break(doc)

# Detail tables
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Detail by variable", style = "heading 2")
for (item in trig_compare) {
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, item$label, style = "heading 3")

  info <- paste0("Variable: ", item$field, " | Type: ", item$type)
  if (!is.na(item$logic) && item$logic != "") info <- paste0(info, " | Branching logic: ", gsub("\n", " ", item$logic))
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, info)
  if (item$issues != "") doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("* Dictionary differences: ", item$issues))
  if (length(item$logic_fail) > 0) {
    doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("* Branching logic not applied (all rows used): ",
                                    paste(item$logic_fail, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_compare_ft(item$table, header_n, item$label))
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")
}

out_docx <- paste0("SAVAC_HOS_RHD_report_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), ".docx")
print(doc, target = out_docx)
out_docx
```
